hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251469 (notice: 'While the standard non-electric sites will support RVs, there are no RV amenities.'; RIDB catalog: all sites NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Three loops, 24 sites: one barrier-free loop for RVs up to 35 ft (9 standard back-in sites on recreation.gov), roadside tent-only sites, and tent-only sites in a grassy area (14 tent-only in all), plus one group site.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251469 ('There are three loops with 24 sites. One loop is fully accessible, barrier free and can accommodate RVs up to 35ft. A second loop features dispersed tent-only roadside sites ... A third loop features tent-only sites') + RIDB catalog 251469 (9 STANDARD NONELECTRIC back-in, 14 TENT ONLY, 1 GROUP), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The two official pages disagree: recreation.gov says 'Vault toilets, drinking water pumps, and bear-proof trash and recycling receptacles are provided', while the Forest Service page (updated May 20, 2026) says 'Restrooms are not available at this site' and 'Potable water is not available at this site'. Campground host on site.

values.note: Standard and tent sites $10 a night; the group site $20 (recreation.gov 2026 rate season from May 18).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251469/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-18 to 2026-12-31: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $10, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC $10, group $20), read 2026-10-22

summary: Forest Service page (read in a browser) and recreation.gov: confirmed $10/night (2026) and no hookups; added 24 sites (9 RV-capable in a barrier-free loop for RVs up to 35 ft), season April 1 - December 31, status open (FS 'Site Open', updated May 2026; nights sold through December), reservable on recreation.gov with some FCFS sites and a self-service fee station. Toilets/water left unset because rec.gov (vault toilets, water pumps) and the FS page (none) disagree. No current FS alert or order for Curtis Creek Road (FR 482) or the campground. Note unchanged.
flags: Missing phone: the entry has none. Grandfather Ranger District, (828) 652-2144 (both the FS page and recreation.gov). Operated by the Forest Service directly (not commercially managed), host on site.

Location lead: the entry's pin (35.6895,-82.1995) is ~1.5 km north of recreation.gov's facility point (35.6761,-82.1992); the FS page gives 35.654952,-82.175479, ~4 km away near US-70. Worth checking the pin on imagery.

Official pages disagree on facilities: recreation.gov lists vault toilets and drinking-water pumps; the FS page (updated May 20, 2026) says restrooms and potable water are not available. Possibly a post-Helene change; recorded in facilities.note only.
